clips.title: The story
paras: At the Lakeshire Inn, Barkeep Daniels keeps drinks flowing as raiders disrupt the roads. The town guards, fishermen, and travelers who gather there depend on the inn for a welcome pause, but supplies are running low.

Barkeep Daniels pours drinks and greets visitors at the Lakeshire Inn, near the bridge. Gnolls and Blackrock orcs have kept Lakeshire under pressure for months, and its defenders turn to the tavern after grim patrols. Raids and severed roads have disrupted trade across the region. With liquor running low when the town needs good cheer, Daniels welcomes travelers willing to fetch shipments from safer settlements.
